name: Daichi
source:
"So, where exactly do I have to press simultaneously on you, Sensei... ...to wipe that memory clean!? Or maybe I need to zip up those memory files and lock them behind a password—strictly 'Top Secret'!"

An android working in sales—and quite the chatterbox.

He has a knack for instantly closing the distance with anyone he meets, always ready to lend a hand and brimming with friendliness.

With his flashy looks and casual way of speaking, he tends to come across as a bit of a lightweight...

...but rumor has it that, deep down, he actually possesses a serious and studious side.

Then one day, after a chance encounter with you... he turns to you and says, "There's something I need you to teach me."
